ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blak and Blu; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues-rock sound fits my recent Hendrix and Clapton listening, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Same Trailer Different Park; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in Blown Away makes this country album appealing, though I am leaning toward blues today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Stockholm; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its roots-rock direction sounds compatible with my recent listening, but it is not my first pick this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: No Fools, No Fun – 2 Track Bonus Version; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy collaboration interests me, but I would need to hear a sample before choosing it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Invisible Empire // Crescent Moon; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for blues guitar and roots-rock energy rather than a quieter acoustic record right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently listened to Old Sock, I would choose this for the Clapton connection and relaxed blues sound.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Made Up Mind; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for its soulful vocals and blues guitar, which fit my interest in Memphis and Hendrix.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Life Journey; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The veteran roots-and-soul approach appeals to me, but my two picks already cover that mood today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Guitar-led blues is relevant to my taste, but I would leave this for a later listening session.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Let's Be Still; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Folk-oriented harmonies are less compelling to me today than the blues and soul in my recent listening.
